sections.title: Vector, live
sections.intro: A neon HUD in hexagons: a faceted sweep that thickens as it climbs and crisp thin digits, violet on black. This is the real wallpaper, drawn in your browser by the app's own code. Tap the big gauge, and try Vector's layouts and colours.

sections.title: About Vector
sections.intro: Vector is a neon HUD built from hexagons: a faceted sweep that thickens as the reading climbs, and crisp thin digits, violet on black.

items.alt: The Vector style, as the wallpaper draws it
items.caption: Vector, drawn by the app itself

items.title: €1.19, once
items.text: Buy Vector once on Google Play and it's yours. On a new phone with the same Google account, it comes back by itself.

items.title: One dial, three jobs
items.text: The big gauge shows power, CPU clock or GPS speed. Tap it on your home screen to switch, as in every style.

items.title: Make it yours
items.text: Customize sets Vector's colours and background, and its units, clock and warning lights.

items.title: Layouts, and your own
items.text: Most styles come in several layouts. You can also drag and resize the gauges and save your own.

sections.title: More styles
sections.intro: Every style runs live on its own page. Or try them all in your browser.
